title.zh: 将Don Jose Sustiguer Monfort纪念国立学校设为西米沙鄢科学技术学院分校，并改设为同名的纪念国立学院的法案
title.en: An Act Making the Don Jose Sustiguer Monfort Memorial National School a Branch of the Western Visayas College of Science and Technology to be known as the Don Jose Sustiguer Monfort Memorial National College (Western Visayas College of Science and Technology Branch)
title.orig: An Act Making the Don Jose Sustiguer Monfort Memorial National School a Branch of the Western Visayas College of Science and Technology to be known as the Don Jose Sustiguer Monfort Memorial National College (Western Visayas College of Science and Technology Branch)

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1990/ra_6946_1990.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Don Jose Sustiguer Monfort Memorial National School is hereby made a branch of the Western Visayas College of Science and Technology to be known as the Don Jose Sustiguer Monfort Memorial National College (Western Visayas College of Science and Technology Branch).

The said college shall offer such courses as are programmed under the charter of the Western Visayas College of Science and Technology, including automotive, electrical communications and computer courses.
The Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall promulgate such rules and regulations to implement the provisions of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in a newspaper of general circulation.
